resources.string: Undersigned is not offered in %1$s because of sanctions and legal restrictions. This check runs on your device only.
Signed app reviews from Seeker owners, written to Solana. Not affiliated with Solana Mobile. Reviews are the opinions of individual owners, not the store\'s ratings.
By signing in you confirm that you:
are not in a sanctioned jurisdiction or on any sanctions list;
accept the Terms, Privacy Policy and EULA (v%1$s);
understand that a review you publish is written to a public blockchain and cannot be deleted by anyone;
understand this app never holds your keys or funds and moves nothing but your own network fee.
No wallet found on this device. You can still browse.
I accept the Terms, Privacy Policy and EULA, am 18+, and am not in a sanctioned jurisdiction.
Without a wallet you can read the ledger and your device facts. Posting a review needs a Seeker wallet with a Genesis Token.
This wallet address appears on a sanctions list and cannot be used with this app.
A trust layer for the dApp Store that nobody owns.
Each review is a memo transaction your wallet signs. Only wallets holding a Seeker Genesis Token are counted, so one device is one voice.
Reviews live on Solana at a fixed address no one controls. Anyone can read them. You can withdraw your review from the ranking, but the text stays on-chain forever.
For apps you have installed, Undersigned shows what the device can verify: the signing certificate and permission changes between versions. Facts, never verdicts.
Undersigned reads the store\'s public catalogue and opens listings in the store. It never installs anything and is not affiliated with Solana Mobile.

Average of Genesis-Token-verified reviews, weighted by staked SKR (capped at 3×). Opinions of individual Seeker owners, not the store\'s rating.
Rank score %1\$s — shrunk toward 3.0 until more Seekers sign; used only to order the list.
Your answer, in your own words (permanent).
Every 6 hours this device re-reads the ledger and notifies you locally about new signed reviews on apps you follow and replies to your own reviews. Nothing leaves the device.
Read from this phone\'s package manager. Facts and changes only; not a safety verdict.

Not installed on this device. Install it from the dApp Store to see device facts.

Your note will be written to the Solana blockchain. It is public and permanent. It cannot be deleted by you, by us, or by anyone. You can withdraw it from this app\'s ranking later, but the text itself stays on-chain forever. Do not include personal data, and only state what you know to be true.
I understand this text is permanent and I am responsible for it.
Sign in with your Seeker wallet to post.
This wallet holds no Seeker Genesis Token, so its reviews would not be counted. Posting is disabled to save you the network fee.
Your wallet pays only the Solana network fee it sets itself (typically under 0.0001 SOL; measured 0.000047 SOL on a Seeker). No value moves. Undersigned takes nothing.
A revocation record will be signed and written on-chain. Readers stop counting your review. The original stays on-chain; nothing can remove it.

Nothing has changed since the last check.
Genesis Token found: your reviews count.
No Genesis Token in this wallet: your reviews would not be counted.
Weights are read from the chain. Undersigned never asks you to stake, buy or hold anything.
Registry address %1$s. Every review is discoverable by anyone through this address. Undersigned runs no server.
Nothing leaves this device except the public addresses in your RPC requests and the reviews you choose to sign. Consent records, hidden lists and device snapshots stay local.
Undersigned v%1$s — not affiliated with Solana Mobile, Solana Foundation or any wallet.
Undersigned reads the public dApp Store catalogue and opens listings in the store. It never installs, updates or removes apps.
